Plot per-model score trajectories from compare_scores()

Source: R/compare_scores.R
plot.mvgam_compare_scores.Rd

Draws a ggplot2 line + point chart of forecast scores from a mvgam_compare_scores object. The shape adapts to the score type:

  • Univariate scores ("crps", "drps", "logs", "brier", "sis", "dss", "qs", "twcrps") plot per-series with one facet panel per series; toggle off with facet = FALSE to overlay every series on one panel.

  • Joint multivariate scores ("energy", "variogram", "twenergy") plot a single panel from the all_series rows.

An ensemble passed to compare_scores() is plotted as one more model and compared with its components.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam_compare_scores'
plot(x, relative = NULL, facet = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

A mvgam_compare_scores object from compare_scores().

relative

Optional character name of a baseline model already in x$model. When supplied, scores are differenced against that model at each series x horizon cell and the plot adds a dashed zero line; negative values then mean "better than the baseline". The baseline model itself is dropped from the plot since its values are identically zero.

facet

Logical. When TRUE (default) univariate scores are faceted by series; when FALSE series are overlaid on one panel with linetype distinguishing them. Ignored for joint scores.

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

compare_scores(), score.mvgam_forecast(), plot.mvgam_compare_elpds(), ensemble.mvgam_forecast()
